source_image_selection.method: Source-driven exact symbolic BFS, one process per trial pinned to core 0 of a dedicated EC2 c7i.4xlarge; CPU topology and memory shape identical across two separate instances. Same-host ratios only. Large is unedited MCKVSSafetyLarge.cfg. Controls include Lamport TCommit with only RM expanded to 32 or 64. All runs retain the original obligations; only the operand of a relational image changes.
source_image_selection.reproduce: dive check MCKVS.tla --config MCKVSSafetyLarge.cfg --strategy symbolic --time-limit 7200s --max-memory 22g --output json. For TCommit use TCommit.tla, --type-invariant TCTypeOK and the RM domain generated by scripts/symbolic/check_transaction_commit.py.

policy.smaller: Use all admitted reached states when their BDD has fewer nodes than the admitted frontier.
policy.reached: Always expand all admitted reached states.

four_key_three_transaction.comparison: The earlier frontier-only 1997.42 s observation under three_transaction_growth has the same counts and depth. Those two timings used separate c7i.4xlarge instances.

source_image_selection.correctness: All small symbolic fragment differentials and pinned KVS goldens passed. Installed-layout controls passed. An independently generated 31-case comparison with explicit Core checked 11 complete results, 20 negative shortest depths and 40 standalone trace replays. Dropping admission from the larger operand failed the excluded-source control.

method: One cold process per trial, sequential in listed order on one exclusive host. GNU time measures full process wall seconds and peak resident KiB. CPython 3.11, dd 0.6.0 with CUDD. State counts are arbitrary-precision JSON integers; use a lossless reader.
implementation: Source exporter and Core binary from e4ab6a13. The four Python files are identified by digest. The measured engine predates the conservative universal-guard restriction merged in #1062. All reported counts, depth, BDD nodes and verdict agree with the merged-source controls.
reproduce: Use the same-host procedure in docs/developer/large-models.md. Run check.py MODULE CFG --type-invariant TypeInvariant (KVS) or TCTypeOK (TCommit) --time-limit 480. Seven and SevenRaw expand the Medium key domain to seven, the latter omits SYMMETRY. check_transaction_commit.py generates the four RM domains.

changed_transition_layers.hardware: EC2 c7i.4xlarge, Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64, pinned to logical CPU 0; sequential fresh processes; 7 GiB address-space budget and 3,000 s time limit per session. GNU time measures overall peak RSS including child processes.
changed_transition_layers.input: tlaplus/Examples KeyValueStore at 6a7b26a31c1a6aeec789b455e9bbfa3b3ad2728f. Use original Medium and Large CFGs and every original obligation and symmetry setting.
changes: Reset sets all five variables to their Init values, from any source. Add Reset as another branch of Next.
Add Reset and OpenAll. OpenAll requires an empty transaction set, opens every transaction, snapshots the current store for every transaction, and leaves store/written/missed unchanged.
changed_transition_layers.command: dive check Revised.tla --strategy symbolic --config BASE --recheck Revised.tla RESET --recheck Revised.tla BASE --recheck Revised.tla OPEN --time-limit 3000s --max-memory 7g --output json
changed_transition_layers.verification: Each edit agrees with a full search under the same executable and the previous worker. Independent BFS checked a 53-revision sequence, 165 frontiers and eight symmetric revisions. Six negative controls per execution replayed independently.

three_transaction_growth.platform: Isolated EC2 c7i.4xlarge, Linux 7.0.0-1018-aws, one physical core via taskset -c 0.
three_transaction_growth.change: Begin with the released KVS Large safety configuration. Change only Key from three to four keys; retain three transaction identities, two values, the original actions, TypeInvariant, TxLifecycle and transaction symmetry.
three_transaction_growth.command: dive check MCKVS.tla --config K4V2T3.cfg --strategy symbolic --time-limit 7200s --max-memory 22g --output json
three_transaction_growth.cross_check: transaction_history_counts(4, 2, 3, True) independently equals both counts in the exhausted symmetry-reduced report. The separate concrete count below is computed from the history formula.
